First release of torsteinvh/OpenComposite, based on [ClarkCheekyKent/OpenComposite](https://github.com/ClarkCheekyKent/OpenComposite) (commit 8724ed7).

## Fix

Apps no longer abort with `Hit stubbed file at ...BaseOverlay.cpp:819 func CreateDashboardOverlay`. OpenComposite has no SteamVR dashboard, so dashboard overlays are now created as ordinary overlays that are never shown. The other dashboard calls (`IsActiveDashboardOverlay`, `SetDashboardOverlaySceneProcess`, `GetDashboardOverlaySceneProcess`, `ShowDashboard`, `GetPrimaryDashboardDevice`) return harmless defaults.

## Install

1. Download the zip for your game's architecture: `x64` for 64-bit games (most current VR games), `x86` for 32-bit games.
2. Close the game and back up its `openvr_api.dll`, for example by renaming it to `openvr_api.dll.bak`.
3. Copy `openvr_api.dll` from the zip into the game folder.
4. Restore the backup to undo the change.

## Status

Pre-release. The build compiles, but the fix has not yet been tested in a game.
